balls.text: almost a yorker nd Shami bunts it down the ground to long-off, they want two but can't get that
Arshdeep throws his hands at the short ball after making room, thick edge reaches Rana at third man after a bounce

deceives him with the slower ball and hits off stump! Prasidh has the last laugh in this last over battle as he lands a length ball at 103kmh on off, Jordan swings again, as expected, but misses it this time
slapped down the ground over the bowler's head for six! Short, slow and wide outside off and Jordan swings hard to send that flying to the long-off boundary
swings for the length ball outside off, it reaches third man after a bounce, there's a fumble as well but they decide against the single. Jordan wants to keep strike
Jordan is on fire! Short ball outside off, Jordan takes out his upper cut and scythes that over the point boundary for six!
drivable length outside off, Shami goes for the big swing but misses completely
attempted wide yorker outside off is actually a low full toss, sliced to deep point
smacks the short ball from off, not right from the middle but the top edge is thick enough to sail high and over the fine-leg boundary for six! Jordan making a useful contribution
short length again, this time outside off, and Jordan misses the pull
short ball into Jordan and he lifts his left leg like Lara to pull that nicely behind square for a four to take them past 100

flick to leg turns into a leading edge high on the off side and taken easily. Cummins angled the short ball into Bishnoi who was way too early to close the face of the bat in front of the stumps, the ball takes the thick outside edge and hangs in the air on the off side before falling in Morgan's hands at cover
quick and short again, gets a thick outside edge to third man
135.6kmh, beats a jumping Bishnoi's outside edge! Good short ball outside off, Bishnoi goes on his toes and jumps to get to the rising ball and nearly edges it behind
moves across to off and sees the short ball sail down leg for a wide
138.3kmh, short outside off, he waits and dabs it to backward point
138kmh, quick and into the body, Jordan tucks the ball to leg for one

connects with the pull this time, but not in control at all and Morgan comes under it at extra cover to pouch it easily. Another big wicket falls for Punjab Kings. Prasidh persisted with the short length, it was a slow cutter, Shahrukh went for his pull and he only managed a top edge which skied the ball
short ball outside off, SRK pulls with hard hands and misses
room on the last ball, he frees his arms with a big drive to deep cover and a fumble in the deep gives them a second
on length outside off, Jordan pushes it back
on middle and leg, got for a big heave but gets only one to deep midwicket. Didn't middle it
Some width now and he drives to sweeper cover for one
Outside off and dabbed to cover
Strikes him on the pad, no chance for a leg bye
fullish outside off and Jordan drives it down to long-off for one. Quick work from the fielder and they settle for one
strikes him on the pads outside leg, Karthik appeals alone
works this length ball again with the turn to leg for one
too full and SRK is not going to leave this one - smoked over deep midwicket! Offbreak around off, SRK reaches the length with his long arms and slog-sweeps with the turn for a big six
keeps low as Shahrukh pulls the shortish ball but misses because of lack of bounce
full outside off, he reaches out and drives to sweeper cover for one
gets width this time and he scythes it away along the ground to third man for two
flat and fuller, and he punches back with hard hands
pitched up and he pushes to silly mid-on
thick inside edge to square leg and Jordan is off the mark

swing and a miss, Pooran loses his off stump! Varun takes off in celebration, Karthik shrieks behind the stumps as Pooran pulls with a big heave but he misses this legbreak completely. Short ball on off, just a bit of turn to retain its line and the ball sneaks under the mighty bat of Pooran
towards the stumps and it's worked down to long-on
flicked in the air through the vacant square leg region for one
slow through the air now around off, worked to short midwicket
flat offbreak outside off, he slices it to short third man
with the angle towards middle from off, Pooran goes back and tucks to leg
chips this length ball over the covers with some risk to get of the mark

bowled'm through the gate! An offbreak from Narine, no mystery there, and it pitches on the perfect length just outside off to bring Henriques forward but he leaves a big gap between bat and pad, and the ball turns in to sneak through and rattle the stumps
no room again and on length on off, drives to cover again
tighter around off now, pushed to cover
short ball follows the fuller one, smacked back through Varun's hands with a lot of power, and he beats a sliding long-on as well
over long-on for six, Pooran's first of this IPL! Pitched up in his arc, he didn't have to move much but only swing his arms down the ground and long-on is pretty wide so no chance for him
short and quick at 93.1kmh towards the stumps, worked to leg with hard hands
goes back and helps the ball towards square leg with the turn
goes back and tucks the ball from off to leg for one, keeps strike
swings for this ball outside off and he loses his bat while swinging as the ball also goes through Karthik. Bottom edge gets him one even as the ball flies to square leg
another short ball and he pulls to deep midwicket for one
forward lean and he blocks the length ball back

tumbles over but that's a great catch from Tripathi at deep midwicket! And it's the big wicket of Agarwal. Short ball again, Agarwal pulled it off the middle but there's a fielder there who runs in a few yards quickly and gets both his hands under the ball in front of him, and then rolls over to complete it
short ball turning in, pulled down towards mid on
tossed up outside off, driven down to long-off for one more
slower length ball on off and middle, Agarwal defends it back
full outside off, he carves it along the ground to deep cover
width on off and Agarwal drives to deep cover for one
down the leg side, he doesn't connect the sweep but they get a run as Karthik can't hold on to it. Looks like Pooran got some glove on it
towards off stump, he goes on the back foot and pushes into the covers
excellent reply from Prasidh, brings the ball off length towards off stump and Agarwal does well to steer it in the gap on off for two
Makes room again, this time he middles this short ball with his pull and cracks a wonderful six over long on!
makes room early, Prasidh replies with an excellent short ball that chases Agarwal who opts to leaves in the end, and it's called a wide for height
right on target this time, on off stump and Agarwal defends off the back foot
cuts and misses outside off! Short of length, Agarwal says back to cut but doesn't connect at all
on length outside off and Pooran punches it to deep point off the back foot
good carry for the short of length ball outside off, Pooran lets it go
Agarwal can't connect with this short ball at all, too early into his shot for this one and it deflects off his body to point
pulls the short ball but doesn't quite middle it, bottom edge towards square leg and he gets one
on the back foot and punches it down to mid-off
back of length on off, he waits and steers it to point
hits him on the pad in front of leg stump, they sneak in a leg bye
tries another dab to third man but finds backward point
dabs the last ball to third man for one. Just three from the over
back of length on the hips and he's off the mark by tucking it to fine leg. He must be relieved

taken at backward point, sharp catch from captain Morgan. Hooda plays on the up and away from the body for this back of length ball well outside off, the seam was pointing towards third man, and he wasn't in control at all while reaching out so far out. Thick edge flew to Morgan who got his hands under the ball in front of him just in time
on the back foot for this incoming delivery and defends to leg, no room to put the away
miscues the pull and it lands just short of long-on! Didn't look that quick, this short ball but Agarwal didn't time it well at all. Long-on was right at the boundary so couldn't make it
short of length around off, Agarwal cuts and finds backward point
guides the back of length ball from outside off to third man and gets one
hurries the short ball onto Hooda who pulls a tad late and gets one towards long leg
much straighter outside off on length and Hooda pushes it down to mid-off
down the leg side past the pads for a wide

big appeal for caught behind on Gayle's first ball! The umpire doesn't move, Karthik is confident there's an edge and reviews even as Gayle's eyes are stuck on the umpire. UltraEdge shows there's a spike when the ball passes the bottom of the bat as Gayle drives away from the body without footwork, it's a first ball duck for Gayle!
nice drive by reaching out away from the body, single to deep cover. Gayle nearly went for two there, but there wasn't one
angling in from wide of the crease, Agarwal finds midwicket again
hangs back and late cuts the ball to third man for a single, and he keeps strike
tucks the ball to leg and wants a quick single, but who's at the other end? Chris Gayle sends Agarwal back quickly

doesn't middle this enough either and he's skied it to mid-off. Made room again for the length ball, lofted it down the ground with a big drive but it wasn't off the middle and Narine had enough time to get under it near the edge of the circle

makes room, and it's another top edge for six! Rahul went wide and Cummins went a bit wide himself as well, Rahul sliced the ball away from his body and got a top edge thick enough to send that flying over third man
stays back and dabs it wide of backward point for one
Agarwal goes on his toes or the incoming delivery, good bounce, and he tucks it to midwicket
pushes this one down towards mid-on and sends Agarwal back immediately
another gentle drive in the covers, third dot in a row
shorter length, straighter line and Rahul punches it back to the bowler
fuller length outside off and Rahul finds cover with another drive
136kmh, back of length outside off, he dabs it to point for one
little full outside off and Rahul drives it down to mid-off for one
more on the leg sideband a single towards midwicket to end the over
offbreak from off to middle, Rahul hangs back and punches to cover
slower and fuller on leg, flicked easily to long-on
turns in from off to middle, Rahul watches and turns it to leg with the spin for one
makes room early again, straighter ball around middle and leg, and Rahul cuts to point this time
too short in front off, Rahul makes room on the back foot and cuts it away in style square of the wicket for a four
squares him up a bit as Agarwal defends off the back foot in front of the stumps and the ball holds its line just a bit. Thick outside edge to the covers this time
120.7kmh, slow offcutter wide outside off, Agarwal waits and pushes into the covers off the inside half of the bat
angling in towards off stump, Rahul waits and defends towards point for one
strays towards the pads and Agarwal gets a leg bye after missing a flick
fuller and straighter, Agarwal drives it hard again, this time to the bowler who gets a hand to it
driven beautifully for four! It wasn't that full but Agarwal can reach out for such deliveries with his forward stride and crack boundaries with a flourishing drive
excellent placement to end the over! Goes on the back foot for the shorter ball and cuts it away past a diving backward point to beat third man as well
just back of length, nagging line outside off and Rahul steers on the off side
length ball towards the stumps, Rahul waits and pushes to mid-on
tight outside off again and Agarwal runs it down to third man
outside off now on length and Agarwal steers it to point
top-edge for six over first slip! Short ball from Cummins, Agarwal pretty much took his eyes of the ball at the end while pulling it wit short hands and the ball flew off the top edge
134kmh, starts off with a big wide down the leg side, but Karthik gets both hands to it
back of length and towards the stumps, keeps a tad low and Rahul defends it back
pushes the length ball gently down to mid-off
pulls the length shorter and Agarwal dabs it late to third man to get off the mark
from wide of the crease and touch fuller towards the stumps, Agarwal pushes to mid-on from the inside half of the bat
brings it in this time towards the stumps and Rahul flicks it away to deep square leg for one
pretty wide and full outside off, Rahul reaches out and drives gently to cover point
middles the pull this time and those are the winning runs for KKR. Another short ball, and the lack of bounce here only helps the batters. Pulled away in style

doesn't really middle the pull off the short ball, but it's a big vacant region at deep midwicket. The ball lands just inside the boundary and just stops there instead of rolling away for four, because of the dew
drives that full delivery straight down the ground and that's beaten a diving mid-off for four! Too full on off stump and Karthik knows how to drive those nice and straight
a slow cutter on the stumps, keeps a bit low but he pulls to leg for one
touch shorter and pushed into the covers for one
and even better this time! Stands still, gets an overpitched delivery around off and lofts that nicely well over the long-off fielder for a clean six!

goes on the attack and drives that all along the ground and right in the gap through the covers for four! Made room as well even as Hooda flighted the ball and he found the gap with the inside-out drive
too full on the stumps, driven down to long-on
touch fuller and this time Morgan steers it towards deep point
keeps low outside off and Morgan can't connect with the cut
short and turning away outside off, Morgan slams it to deep cover for one. And keeps strike
Too wide outside off, Morgan cuts and finds backward point
sweeps against the turn and gets a top edge over the slips for two
another chance for a run-out! Not really. Karthik tucked the ball to midwicket and took off quickly, and even put in a dive at the bowler's end and the ball struck him instead of hitting the stumps
on length outside off and driven to mid off

has Russell made it? The umpire just wants to check if the ball has struck the stumps and not Rahul's gloves without the ball, and Russell is run-out! Morgan cut the googly to short third man and they took off for a single, Russells knees are not the fittest in the world but he responded for a single, stretched to try and make it, but the sharp throw from Arshdeep hit the base of the stumps and found him short
the last ball keeps low in front of off, Morgan helps it into the covers and keeps strike
that was remarkably quicker at 148.4kmh, but not as much bounce as Russell swat-pulls it to deep square leg
and another mistimed Russell pull races away to the fine leg boundary off the inside edge. Unlucky for Jordan
almost in the slot outside off, he slams it straight to extra cover in the circle
charges down for the short ball outside off and slices to deep point
length ball angling in, Morgan tucks to midwicket

appeal for lbw because it's another wrong'un but even the bowler knows it was going down leg. On length on the stumps and turns in sharply without much bounce, Russell might be struck in front of leg but the ball had enough turn
falls just short of deep midwicket! Morgan went a long way across and swept the ball flat in the air, and Allen did well to stop that even though the ball landed right in front of him
another cut and miss from Morgan against Bishnoi's wrong'un
the slip might be to bluff him, he turns it into Russell from off and he helps the ball to deep square
turning from leg towards middle, worked to leg for one
beats Morgan's sweep with a wrong'un outside off
super yorker to end the over, Russell has no option but to block it out
Russell is lucky to get off the mark with a four. An accurate short ball from Shami, doesn't bounce as much and Russell pulls but only gets an inside edge while runs away to the fine leg boundary
nearly in the block hole again and Russell drills that straight to mid-on with a big swing
right in the block hole just outside leg, Russell has to clear his front leg and dig it out
full on the stumps, Morgan swings it down to long-on
on length outside off, pushed into the covers and Russell doesn't want a quick single

Tripathi finds Shahrukh at long-on, the bowling change has worked! Tripathi charged down lofted the length ball down but didn't get the distance, and Shahrukh went to his left to grab that along with a tumble
flighted outside off, driven wide of the bowler to long-off
pushes the length ball back to the bowler from middle stump
on middle and leg, worked with the turn to leg for one
on the pads and he sweeps that away behind square with so much power that it beats a fine leg on the move
pretty slow outside off, driven into the covers
pulls the short ball to deep midwicket, there's a big  gap there and Bishnoi has to run a long way to his left from deep square
short ball rising on him, he wants to ramp over the keeper but misses
full outside off, driven straight to Gayle at cover
delicate! Stays back this time for the incoming delivery from outside off and just opens the face of the bat late enough to send that fine to third man for four
charges down and chips the ball over the covers in the gap for two
tight line for the rising ball on middle stump, it hurries on to Tripathi who defends it back
quick legbreak outside off, dabbed towards point for a quick single
reverse-sweeps this full toss to third man area for one
flighted outside off, driven with hard hands to deep cover

past a sliding Arshdeep at fine leg and it's four! Tripathi went a long way across to expect another googly and he paddled the ball fine where Arshdeep ran to his right with a dive but couldn't keep the ball in
goes back in the crease and bunts it down to long-on

stumping missed! Tripathi came down the track and only got bat and pad on that googly, and the ball went past the leg stump, but it all happened too quickly in front of Rahul. Tripathi was a long way outside had Rahul collected it
too much room outside off and Morgan slashes that over the covers for a cracking one-bounce four! Enough width on that length ball for Morgan to are his arms and he swings them nicely
just back of length outside off, pushed to cover point
back of length outside off, he steers it to deep point
143.5kmh, errs down the leg side and that's four leg byes. Off his pads and fine on the leg side, Rahul puts in a dive to his left but can't get a hand to it
fuller now towards the stumps and he flicks to midwicket where Gayle dives again to stop the ball
too short and Tripathi knows the gap behind square, all he does is stay back in the crease, and lap the ball with the angle just behind the square leg region
95.2kmh, short ball comes in and keeps low, goes off Tripathi's front pad to short fine leg for a leg bye
moves across in front of off stump now and steers the length ball to off
wrong'un again, even though it pitched well outside off, Morgan stretches out a fair bit for the  cut and misses
wrong'un towards off, Tripathi works it down the ground for one
short ball going away again, Morgan gets a bottom edge towards long-off this time
starts with a slider from wide of the crease, beats Morgan
towards middle stump this time and Tripathi helps it straight to midwicket
137kmh, just outside off from Shami, no room whatsoever and Tripathi pushes into the covers
nice and tight around off, worked into the covers
clears his front foot for a big shot, but there's no room and he gets an inside edge towards off for a quick single
stays still and defends the length ball back

another misfield from Bishnoi, another boundary! Morgan only punched the ball without much follow through towards cover point and Bishnoi had to slide to his right just a bit, but he let the ball slip through once again

through Bishnoi's hands and legs at third man for four! Arshdeep is not happy, because Bishnoi got to the ball and let it slip, was it the dew? A slow cutter well outside off, Tripathi went hard at it and scythed wide of point, Bishnoi ran to his left from deep backward point and couldn't hold on to it
moves a long way across to off, Arshdeep pitches it on length towards him and he defends to point
comes down again, makes just a bit of room even though the ball is coming in and Tripathi smartly steers it late behind short third man for four
too short outside off, both fielders in the deep on leg, and Morgan gets one for the pull
charges down this time with some room and slashes the back of length ball to deep point
angling in towards the stumps, a watchful Tripathi defends

charges down and lofts that over the covers, it's gone really high but it won't go all the way. Lands just inside the boundary and Bishnoi slides and pulls the ball back but he might have touched the rope with his leg while doing so. Yes, replays show he has and that's four
length ball on the stumps, he defends it back
short ball and smoked over square leg for six! Morgan plays that shot really well, and he got good pace on that short ball, and the angle to middle that on the leg side

direct hit at the non-striker's end from Chris Gayle, is it four down? Morgan tucked the ball to leg and Tripathi wanted a run but he was sent back, Gayle dived to his right, fired in a direct hit at the bowler's end, and Tripathi dives as well but he's disappointed and is walking back. But hang on, replays show his bat was in, and he's coming back!
back of length outside off, pushed into the covers

that's the greatest catch of this IPL already, Ravi Bishnoi has taken a stunner and is running away with the ball, someone stop him! Narine would have finally thought he's connected with a heave, and he did off that back of length ball, but it also went pretty high on the leg side, and Bishnoi ran and ran to his right from deep midwicket and put in a sliding dive at just the right time to pluck the ball a split-second before it could touch the ground. He can't believe it himself he's taken it
some room outside off with that length ball and he drives it straight to cover
whips and manages only a leg bye off his pads for a quick single towards point
heaves and misses! Short of length and coming in, and it nearly kisses the top of leg stump as Narine swings wildly and misses it
too much width and he slashes that to deep point for one
starts with a short ball to Tripathi just over off, and the batter does well for the ball to come to him and then ramp it with good timing to send that flying over short third man
short of length and chasing him again with the line, pushed down to mid-on this time
short ball straightaway to Narine, but it's gone down leg with the angle and called a wide. Wasn't too far from Narine's bat as he pulled, Rahul even appealed for the catch

struck right in front, Shami knows it's out, umpire gives it immediately and Gill is walking, no point reviewing that. This one also pitched on length in front of off but didn't go straight like the previous ball, it nipped in, beat the batter who went for a cross-batted shot and was plumb
straight and tight on off stump, Gill blocks it back
too full on the stumps and Gill flicks that with some control and power, and sends that crashing to the square leg boundary
on length on off, he stays back and tucks to midwicket
the length ball keeps a bit low outside off, Gill adjusts and defends
125.5kmh, short offcutter nipping in from around off, he waits and dabs it to short third man
another full toss, this one was dipping on Tripathi and he pushes it down to mid off

full toss chipped to cover! I've not seen a softer dismissal this IPL, and Rana is really disappointed with himself. Innocuous full toss well outside off, Rana merely chips it in the air and Shahrukh dives to his right to grab it with both hands and that's a duck for Rana
short ball this time and he pulls it easily to deep square leg
outside off now and he pushes it down to mid-off this time
poor line first ball on the leg side and Gill only has tuck get just a bit of bat to send that rolling on the leg side for a first ball four
